Taxes are tributes levied by the government on citizens' income and business profits to maintain the territory's upkeep and protection. The lord of a land can make its people pay taxes. If payment is not made on time, a citizen may be evicted from the land, or under certain conditions, payment may be made in agricultural goods promised at harvest time.

Team Liquid (known in-game as just "Liquid") is one of the top raiding guilds in retail World of Warcraft, found on the Illidan US realm. They participate in the Race to World First event by competing to be the first to finish the new raid on Mythic difficulty. They also participate in other WoW-related esports events. Originally known as Limit, they were a top raiding guild that won the early‑2020 Race to World First before partnering with (rebranding to Complexity Limit), later departing in 2022 to join as Liquid.
